test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

The manager said to the employee, “ Why were you absent yesterday?”

options.text: The manager asked the employee why he had been absent the previous day.
The manager told the employee why he had been absent the previous day.
The manager asked the employee why had been he absent the previous day.
The manager enquired the employee for his absence the previous day.

solution:
"The correct answer is **'Option 1'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "The manager said to the employee, “ Why were you absent yesterday?”" is in direct speech.
 
• When transformed to indirect speech, the correct pronoun is "he" from the manager's perspective and past perfect tense is used according to reporting verb in past tense.
 
• Among the gives options, option 1, "The manager asked the employee why he had been absent the previous day." is the correct conversion to indirect speech.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: "The manager told the employee why he had been absent the previous day." Here, "told" is not the right word to use for questions in indirect speech.
 
• Option 3: "The manager asked the employee why had been he absent the previous day." This option doesn't follow the proper word order for a question in indirect speech.
 
• Option 4: "The manager enquired the employee for his absence the previous day." The word 'for' makes the sentence structure incorrect.
